title: OpenClaw Daily Briefing vs IFTTT vs Zapier: Why Agents Win
summary: OpenClaw, IFTTT, and Zapier all run automations — but only one wakes up before you, thinks about your day, and sends a digest that actually helps. Here's the honest comparison.
body_markdown: Depends on usage. Zapier's Professional plan (750 tasks/month) costs $29.99/month. Blink Claw runs OpenClaw from about $45/month per agent, with AI model usage billed from your workspace credits on top. For heavy Zapier users running thousands of tasks, Zapier can cost more. For personal automation with a daily briefing and a handful of recurring tasks, Zapier's entry plan is cheaper, but Blink Claw includes capabilities Zapier can't offer.
